annotations.title: Look up a domain's public records

description: Use this when someone asks about one existing domain: which registrar it is with, when it was registered and expires, whether it is locked, its nameservers and DNS host, its email setup (MX, SPF, DMARC) and whether its website answers over HTTPS. Public records only; owner contact details are not returned.
